                <jats:p>
                  OmicsLake is an R package for version-aware, dataset-level lineage in R/Bioconductor exploratory workflows. It associates stored versions with dependencies captured within tracked
                  <jats:monospace>ref()–dplyr–save_as()</jats:monospace>
                  pipelines or supplied explicitly, and can attach caller-supplied human or software-agent identifiers. Controlled tests recovered all ground-truth edges within the supported path and enabled explicit recovery of an overwritten tagged intermediate. OmicsLake 0.99.3 is MIT-licensed software available at
                  <jats:ext-link xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" ext-link-type="uri" xlink:href="https://github.com/matsui-lab/OmicsLake">https://github.com/matsui-lab/OmicsLake</jats:ext-link>
                  (tag
                  <jats:monospace>v0.99.3</jats:monospace>
                  ); source, tests, and evaluation files are archived at
